title: Algebraic Geometry (VI ELGA)
institution: CIMPA (Centre International de Mathématiques Pures et Appliquées)
level: Master's students, doctoral students and early-career researchers
about: CIMPA lists the VI Latin American School on Algebraic Geometry (VI ELGA) at Universidad de Antioquia in Medellín, Colombia, from 21 June to 2 July 2027, for graduate students, postdocs and young mathematicians. The application deadline is 21 February 2027.
requirements: See the official CIMPA school page for eligibility
card_alt: Card for the CIMPA (Centre International de Mathématiques Pures et Appliquées) school Algebraic Geometry (VI ELGA) in Medellín, Colombia, deadline 21 Feb 2027. The photo shows Las Lajas Sanctuary in Ipiales, Colombia, not Medellín.
